newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns AA+ to TEPCO 4 bln Ffr 10-yr straights.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AA+ to TEPCO 4 bln Ffr 10-yr straights.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it had assigned an AA+ rating to Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc's (TEPCO) 6.5 percent four billion French franc straight bond due September 27, 2006.
The rating outlook is stable, it said.
The rating reflected TEPCO's strong position as the dominant provider of electricity to Japan's eastern region, and an acceptable level of financial risk, it said.

The company also benefits from financing advantages and support from the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) as well as close cooperation from other electric power companies, it added.
